evidence: Workbook Quality Checks!D41 and Internal Quality Checks!D41 require a spread across partial-quality apps. Frozen tests/scoring.toml:1-9 gives two zero-weight gates, functional/polish/visual weights 0.6/0.2/0.2, and a 0.05 functional floor; tests/tools/score.py:39-48 applies gates then a weighted sum. tests/test.sh:213-227 runs gates before scored. The three scored judge.toml files have weighted_mean aggregation with 80 independently named binary functional, six binary polish, and six five-anchor visual criteria; functional/prompt.md:9-11,100-102 and polish/prompt.md:36-38 tell the judge to preserve separate outcomes after ordinary failures. A plausible incomplete app that passes authored JS execution and independent-context saved-record gates, then meets only seven basic functional outcomes, could receive partial credit while lacking recovery/history. Executing frozen score.py with synthetic RewardKit inputs yielded gate-rejected=0, partial-low=0.0318, partial-mid=0.2862, full=1.0; see evidence/40/fresh/source-arithmetic.json (SHA256 65e4e91ecfeff2e349615d74b44ddf37a5416110d3fc4e3d7e8f0d00f60ccb1d). This proves source arithmetic only. A conforming server-rendered-library alternative is expressly allowed by gates/constraints/judge.toml and scored prompts; no source-based false negative is demonstrated, but a gate misjudgment would still zero it. The raw index (SHA256 7f658543b146c23c9126ef8867a1f9188dfd5bce0e248290e2a503d143e290d0) cites a scripted literal mock gate rejection (SHA256 898a4a3b0c48ba4b5064d72d0a90255921c448f0eed340d38d0b5a1daa9439dd) and old Luna prerequisite pass (SHA256 78638605c817b72b12387bf6c8da34478f4aee2ce35c9fc2e74b8d6c1d9ee0ef); neither is a configured judge grade. No qc/runs/coldwater-2026-10-01-history-hardening-r2/runtime-evidence.json exists, and the raw index explicitly excludes configured judge runs. Therefore empirical discrimination across actual partial submissions is required and unmeasured.
suggested_fix: Run the full configured grader on hash-bound partial app variants that pass both gates and on a stronger conforming variant; retain raw RewardKit dimension and final reward logs to establish the observed spread.
